audited_plan.image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a surface. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates arranged in a linear series. The plates are greyish-green with mottled patterns and visible growth lines. A dark, textured girdle surrounds the plates. The anterior end is blunt and lacks visible eyes or tentacles.
